summary: Range De is a Peer-to-Peer lending platform regulated by RBI.
description:
Range De is a Peer-to-Peer lending platform regulated by RBI. Money flows directly from individuals who want to invest (Social Investors) to rural entrepreneurs who need affordable loans without a bank in between. Rang De is the secure, regulated bridge that makes this happen.
Catalytic capital where we fund 6 NGOs to join the peer-lending platform. We also provide a standby limited guarantee. Rang De provides 8-8.5% simple interest loans-collateral-free, customised to each person's livelihood cycle. Borrowers repay when their income arrives. Catalytic Investment ₹7.68 Lakhs (₹2.88L Partnership fees + ₹4.8L sustainability fund). Credit Unlocked ₹22.35 Lakhs- a 10× multiplier on partnership fees. 124 farmers supported of which 99% women. Six NGOs supported-Seva Mandir Rural & Tribal farmers, Locavore Organic, Humsafar Trust LGBTQ, Atypical Advantage PwD, Kiwaad Foundation Youth Skilling, Taliru Foundation women as auto drivers. 1000 borrower beneficiaries. Project cost Rs 27 lakhs.
